stages.goal: Build a picture of motion, force, energy, waves and circuits using everyday examples and simple algebra. Learn to read graphs and check units.

resources.title: Physics (Khan Academy)
resources.author: Khan Academy
resources.note: Short videos with practice questions, starting from one-dimensional motion.

resources.title: The Physics Classroom Tutorial

resources.note: Plain-language lessons with diagrams; good first reading for each topic.
resources.note_ko: 쉬운 말과 그림으로 된 단원별 설명; 각 주제의 첫 읽을거리로 좋음.

resources.title: PhET Interactive Simulations
resources.author: University of Colorado Boulder
resources.note: Browser simulations for forces, circuits, waves and more.
resources.note_ko: 힘, 회로, 파동 등을 다루는 브라우저용 시뮬레이션.

resources.title: HyperPhysics
resources.author: Carl R. Nave, Georgia State University
resources.note: Linked concept maps; use it to look up a formula or idea.
resources.note_ko: 개념 지도가 서로 연결된 사이트; 공식이나 개념을 찾아볼 때 사용.

resources.title: Conceptual Physics (Light and Matter)
resources.author: Benjamin Crowell
resources.note: Free textbook that explains ideas with little math.
resources.note_ko: 수식을 적게 쓰고 개념을 설명하는 무료 교과서.

stages.goal: Cover the full algebra-based high-school syllabus (AP Physics 1/2, A-level, IB) and get used to multi-step problems with diagrams.
stages.goal_ko: 대수 기반 고등학교 물리 전 범위(AP Physics 1/2, A-level, IB)를 다루고, 그림을 그려 여러 단계로 푸는 문제에 익숙해집니다.

resources.title: Physics (high school)
resources.author: OpenStax
resources.note: Free high-school textbook, readable online or as PDF.

resources.author: OpenStax
resources.note: Same level as AP; many worked examples and end-of-chapter problems.
resources.note_ko: AP와 같은 수준; 예제와 단원 끝 문제가 많음.

resources.title: AP Physics 1
resources.author: Khan Academy
resources.note: Units follow the AP Physics 1 course, with quizzes.
resources.note_ko: AP Physics 1 과정 순서의 단원과 퀴즈.

resources.title: AP Physics 2
resources.author: Khan Academy
resources.note: Fluids, thermodynamics, E&M, optics and modern physics.
resources.note_ko: 유체, 열역학, 전자기, 광학, 현대물리.

resources.title: AP Physics 1 past exam questions
resources.author: College Board
resources.note: Official free-response questions with scoring guidelines.
resources.note_ko: 채점 기준이 포함된 공식 서술형 기출 문제.

resources.author: University of Cambridge
resources.note: A-level problem sets with hints; also used for BPhO practice.

resources.title: AP Physics C: E&M past exam questions

stages.goal_ko: 열역학, 광학, 상대론, 실험을 포함한 전 범위에서 국가 결선과 IPhO/APhO/EuPhO 수준에 도달합니다. 지난 대회의 긴 다단계 문제를 풉니다.

resources.title: Physics Olympiad Handouts (later units)

resources.author: Jaan Kalda (Physics Cup)

resources.title: IPhO results and year pages

resources.title: The Feynman Lectures on Physics

math.note_ko: 이 단계에서는 대수만으로 충분합니다. 공식 변형을 연습하세요.

resources.author: Khan Academy

math.note_ko: 근사와 진동 방정식은 대부분의 올림피아드 문제에 나옵니다.

resources.title: Differential Equations
resources.author: Paul Dawkins (Paul's Online Math Notes)

resources.note_ko: 무료 미적분 교과서; 도함수, 적분, 선형 근사 복습.

resources.title: 18.02SC Multivariable Calculus
